name: Xirp

runner.notes: Install the macOS Xirp beta (curl install script or download), authenticate guest coding CLIs (Claude Code, Codex, and/or Gemini) outside Xirp, open only runs/<run-id>/worktree as a project, create a session with prompt.md, then harness-verify. Record Xirp version, guest agent/model, Portal connected or not, and interventions. Do not treat Portal-catalog launches as parity with plain local project sessions.

inclusion: Direct Class A multi-agent ADE: Spotify-built macOS desktop control plane for parallel Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini sessions with Git worktrees, PR monitoring, skills/rules, and optional Spotify Portal institutional context.
pricing_model: Public beta download for macOS; Portal instance access offered with beta (free Portal trial messaging on site). Commercial pricing for Xirp alone was not published on reviewed pages. Non-Mac platforms waitlisted.
